control.description-key: Timeline and deterministic explanation of unified routing decisions for a single conversation.

property.name: enableContextBridge
property.description-key: EXPERIMENTAL, off by default. When Yes, the control also listens for an optional same-origin BroadcastChannel message published by the pwr_conversationcontext_bridge.js form script (see docs/architecture.md). Never disables manual paste or the bound/pwr_id inputs, which always take priority.
